summary: OutOfMemoryError in SortMergeJoin with spilled partitioned rows during shuffle
description: When performing SortMergeJoin with skewed partitioning keys, ShuffleExternalSorter attempts to allocate a continuous memory page beyond the unified memory manager threshold, triggering an unrecoverable java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space.
environment_log: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space at org.apache.spark.memory.TaskMemoryManager.allocatePage(TaskMemoryManager.java:310) at org.apache.spark.util.collection.unsafe.sort.UnsafeExternalSorter.growPointerArrayIfNecessary(UnsafeExternalSorter.java:234) at org.apache.spark.sql.execution.joins.SortMergeJoinExec.doExecute(SortMergeJoinExec.scala:189)
comment_log: Configured spark.sql.shuffle.partitions to dynamic coalesce and added page spilling bounds check.

summary: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in JapaneseTokenizer when parsing unvoiced sound marks
description: JapaneseTokenizer throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException when encountering consecutive half-width kana unvoiced sound marks without a leading base character. The morphological analyzer buffer pointer advances past array slice bounds.
environment_log: java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 128 out of bounds for length 128 at org.apache.lucene.analysis.ja.JapaneseTokenizer.incrementToken(JapaneseTokenizer.java:412) at org.apache.lucene.index.DocInverterPerField.processFields(DocInverterPerField.java:114)
comment_log: Fixed buffer resize policy and added boundary assertion for isolated kana markers.

summary: Consumer deadlock on heartbeat thread when committing offset synchronously during rebalance
description: KafkaConsumer hangs indefinitely if commitSync() is called inside consumer rebalance listener while heartbeat thread attempts to acquire the coordinator lock.
environment_log: Found one Java-level deadlock: 'kafka-coordinator-heartbeat-thread': waiting to lock monitor 0x00007f (object 0x000, a ConsumerCoordinator), which is held by 'main' 'main': waiting to lock monitor 0x00008b, held by 'kafka-coordinator-heartbeat-thread' at org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.internals.ConsumerCoordinator.commitSync(ConsumerCoordinator.java:620)
comment_log: Refactored locking order to use non-reentrant Lock and timed poll synchronization.

summary: S3AFileSystem fails with AmazonClientException on multi-part upload aborted token
description: S3AFileSystem fails when completing a multi-part upload if an IAM STS token expires during massive binary transfer. The client driver does not refresh credentials prior to the final CompleteMultipartUploadRequest.
environment_log: com.amazonaws.AmazonClientException: The provided token has expired at com.amazonaws.auth.AWSCredentialsProviderChain.getCredentials(AWSCredentialsProviderChain.java:136) at org.apache.hadoop.fs.s3a.S3AFileSystem.close(S3AFileSystem.java:940)
comment_log: Added preemptive token refresh hook in S3AUtils before multipart commit stage.
